column1: # 1.21.11 (NeoForge 21.11, FML 11): the harness renames are those of 1.21.10, plus the rows below.
# Measured against the 1.21.11 sources (neoforge-21.11.45-sources.jar) on the Epic Core API port's Gate A.
# The 26.x split starts here: ResourceLocation is Identifier (CATALOG V4, a pure type rename). The harness uses only this table,
# not the fork's generated moves (tools/port_gates.py harness_layer_target), so a class that MOVED needs its row here too.
# GameRules moved into its own package (the harness builds a LevelSettings with one; the 7-argument LevelSettings constructor is unchanged).
# ResourceKey.location() -> identifier(), anchored on the two producers the harness iterates (registry-entry keys and holder keys).
# DataLivenessGameTest names the ResourceKey it is checking `key`.
